entries.flavor: A faint draft sighs through hairline seams in the stone, carrying a distant, hollow echo.
The air hangs heavy with a sharp odor of ozone, sulfur, and ancient damp mildew.
Velvety patches of black mold and pale bioluminescent lichen crust the damp masonry.
A persistent, rhythmic dripping drops into shallow mineral puddles pooled across the uneven floor.
Jagged claw gouges and dragging trails are freshly pressed into the thick silt and dust.
Notched weapon scoring, broken arrow shafts, and dried dark stains testify to a desperate clash.
Scattered calcified bones and gnawed ribs lie partially buried beneath crumbled plaster.
A heap of discarded refuse, splintered crates, and corroded iron buckles clutters the shadows.
A toppled stone balustrade and splintered timber beams lie collapsed in a chaotic tangle.
Faded geometric glyphs and chiseled warning pictograms wrap around the lintel and threshold.
Shadows lean at unnatural angles, and dust motes hang suspended as if caught in localized stasis.
A suffocating, dead silence grips the chamber; your own heartbeat thumps loudly in your ears.
